grep " /tools " /proc/mounts;python3 -S -c "import os,sys;v=list(os.environ.values())+sys.path+[sys.executable,sys.prefix];assert all(\"/tools\" not in x for x in v);print(\"PYTHON_TREE_TOOLS_FREE\")"
